text:
𝗦𝗟 𝟴𝟱/𝟲 𝗔𝗧 𝗟𝗨𝗡𝗖𝗛! 🇵🇰🔥

Abbas: 2/12 in 11 overs, 5 maidens. Razaullah took 2 too. SL were 36/5 before Kusal Mendis made 32.

Can SL reach 200? 👇 #PAKvSL #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗦𝗟 𝟴𝟱/𝟲 𝗟𝗨𝗡𝗖𝗛 𝗞𝗘 𝗦𝗔𝗠𝗔𝗬! 🇵🇰🔥

👉 Rawalpindi Test mein Pakistan ne toss jeet kar bowling li, Sri Lanka 29 overs mein 85/6
👉 Mohammad Abbas: 11 overs, 5 maidens, sirf 12 run, 2 wicket
👉 Razaullah ke bhi 2 wicket; Kusal Mendis ne 32 banaye

Kya Sri Lanka 200 tak pahunchegi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #PAKvSL #Cricket
